summary: Security vulnerabilities detected in Rust dependencies (rustls-webpki GHSA-pwjx-qhcg-rvj4 and tar-rs CVE-2026-33055/33056) via Trivy scan. Fixed versions available via dependabot PRs awaiting maintainer review.
userImpact: Applications using the Python SDK remain exposed to known security vulnerabilities in transitive dependencies until the SDK is updated.
rootCause: Outdated versions of rustls-webpki and tar-rs contain known CVEs that are publicly disclosed.
proposedFix: Update rustls-webpki to 0.103.10 and tar-rs to 0.4.45 via dependabot PRs.
keyQuote: While running Trivy scan on my projects, I see the following issues being raised... Can these PRs be processed by maintainers and included in a future release?
